---
title = "Customization"
---

Customize your *Calepin* website with templates, modules, and themes.

## Templates

Override any built-in template by placing a file in
`index_calepin/templates/{engine}/{name}.{ext}`.

Run `calepin templates eject` to copy all built-in templates into your project for customization.

## Modules

Add custom modules in `index_calepin/modules/{name}/module.toml` and enable them
with the `plugins` field in your config or front matter.

## Themes

Apply a built-in theme or create your own with `calepin extra themes`.
